summary: Activation log level is Error, Info or Debug; other fields are optional Kubernetes service name for exposed ports, enabled toggle, variables (like ansible-rulebook --vars) and Skip audit events; on shutdown pending tasks are cancelled.
questions: How do I set the log level of a rulebook activation?

What is the service name field on an activation?
